findings.title: Untested null-credentials guard in resolveCapability
findings.problem: No test ever makes getStoredAnalyticsCredentials resolve null, so the `if (!stored) return 'evidence';` early return is never exercised.
findings.impact: If this guard regresses, forwarderIdentity(stored.credentials) throws on the null stored value, the Promise.all in collectDeliveryHealth rejects, and the call falls into the outer catch — losing credentials_expired/auth_rejected/identity_mismatch/send_failed reporting too, not just classification_unreachable, for any profile with no stored analytics credentials.
findings.recommendation: Add a delivery-health.test.ts case with getStoredAnalyticsCredentials.mockResolvedValue(null) asserting collectDeliveryHealth still resolves normally instead of collapsing to status:'unknown'.
findings.check_notes: delivery-health.test.ts:239-243 adds 'still resolves normally when there is no stored analytics credential', mocking getStoredAnalyticsCredentials to null and asserting resolveCapability's guard is exercised (summarizeSpoolDelivery called with 'evidence').

fix.change: Added a test asserting collectDeliveryHealth resolves normally (not 'unknown') when getStoredAnalyticsCredentials resolves null.
fix.test: src/cli/commands/proxy/__tests__/delivery-health.test.ts > 'still resolves normally when there is no stored analytics credential'

findings.title: AC7 test matrix missing evidence/organization_encoding case
findings.problem: There is a capability:'evidence' non-flag test for publication_contract_unavailable, but none for organization_encoding_unsupported — that reason is only tested at capability:'unknown' (the flagging case).
findings.impact: The AC2 no-false-positive guarantee for organization_encoding_unsupported is unverified by any test, leaving a gap in the spec's required coverage (AC7).
findings.recommendation: Add a 'does not flag classification_unreachable when capability is evidence' test for the organization_encoding_unsupported hold reason, mirroring the existing publication_contract_unavailable case.
findings.check_notes: delivery-summary.test.ts:135-140 adds the missing evidence/organization_encoding_unsupported non-flag case, mirroring the existing publication_contract_unavailable test; AC7 matrix is now complete.

fix.change: Added the missing evidence/organization_encoding_unsupported non-flag test to the AC7 matrix.
fix.test: src/providers/plugins/sso/proxy/plugins/otlp-spool/__tests__/delivery-summary.test.ts > 'does not flag classification_unreachable for organization_encoding_unsupported when capability is evidence'

findings.title: classification_unreachable gate misfires on legacy capability
findings.problem: summarizeSession gates classification_unreachable on `capability !== 'evidence'`, which also matches capability 'legacy'.
findings.impact: policy-cache.ts defines Capability as 'evidence' | 'legacy' | 'unknown', and tick-processor.ts treats any capability !== 'unknown' (so including 'legacy') as authoritative/backend-consulted. A session held publication_contract_unavailable or organization_encoding_unsupported against a reachable legacy backend (one that answered 404, predating the policy endpoint) would be falsely reported classification_unreachable — exactly the false positive AC2 rules out. No test exercises capability 'legacy'.
findings.recommendation: Narrow the gate to `capability === 'unknown'` (the only value meaning the backend has never answered), and add a test covering capability:'legacy' staying unflagged.
findings.check_notes: delivery-summary.ts:42 narrows the gate to capability === 'unknown' (was !== 'evidence'); delivery-summary.test.ts:142-147 adds 'does not flag classification_unreachable when capability is legacy (backend was reachable)', confirming the false positive is closed.

fix.change: Narrowed the classificationUnreachable gate in delivery-summary.ts from `capability !== 'evidence'` to `capability === 'unknown'`, so a reachable 'legacy' backend no longer misfires.
fix.test: src/providers/plugins/sso/proxy/plugins/otlp-spool/__tests__/delivery-summary.test.ts > 'does not flag classification_unreachable when capability is legacy (backend was reachable)'

deferred.title: Corrupt/unreadable policy-cache file reads as never-probed
deferred.problem: load() returns null on any parse failure, schema mismatch or identity mismatch, and getPolicyState then reports capability:'unknown', indistinguishable from a namespace that was truly never probed.
deferred.preexisting: Behavior of policy-cache.ts's load()/getPolicyState predates this change; AC4 explicitly excludes modifying policy-cache.ts, and the cache self-heals via refreshPolicy on the namespace's next active session tick.
